dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual and consistent geometric narrowing from the mid-section toward the posterior peduncle, forming a sharp 2D triangular profile.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Minor irregular deviations along both lateral margins, likely resulting from surface water turbidity and wave refraction.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Uniform slate dark-grey pigmentation across the visible dorsal area.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Presence of a light-colored longitudinal linear mark along the posterior dorsal midline.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A pale, elongated linear mark or ridge is visible extending along the central dorsal axis toward the peduncle.
